verdict.rationale: Vue ships distinct major API versions: a first-party 'Migration from Vue 2' guide and a 'Get Security Updates for Vue 2' page imply a documented transition path and end-of-support for the older version. A community comment also credits the project with redesigning its public API while keeping users happy. However, the evidence contains only page titles, and no explicit deprecation policy, timelines or semver commitment is shown. Missing for 10: an explicit documented deprecation policy with timelines, semver/versioning guarantees, per-API deprecation warnings, and in-depth first-party content beyond page titles.
